svg.text: Which assets carry the risk, and what should we do?
risk score combines failure frequency, downtime and replacement value · each bar shows the contribution of the three
replacement asset value by criticality band
40% of value sits on criticality-1 assets, and they take 43% of downtime.
That ratio is the argument for condition monitoring.
asset count by installed age · shaded band is beyond typical design life
152 assets beyond 18 years · 17% of the fleet
